MathConstant.Name: TP dt smooth
MathConstant.Comment: Time window to smooth all data over

MathExpression.Comment: Longitudinal acceleration signal to use for traction potential
MathExpression.Script: smooth('Accel Long' [m/s/s], 'TP dt smooth' [])

MathExpression.Comment: Lateral acceleration signal to use for traction potential
MathExpression.Script: abs(smooth('Accel Lat' [m/s/s], 'TP dt smooth' []))

MathExpression.Comment: Vertical acceleration signal to use for traction potential
MathExpression.Script: -derivative(derivative(smooth('GNSS Altitude' [m], 2.0), 1.0), 1.0)

MathExpression.Comment: Current +ve X position on the traction circle
MathExpression.Script: abs(choose('TP Ax' [G] > 0, max(0, 'TP Ax' [G] + 'TP Az' [G]), min(0, 'TP Ax' [G] + 'TP Az' [G])))
stat_max('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G], 1, range_change("Outings:Laps"))
stat_max('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G])
choose('TP Use Manual' [], 'TP TCx Manual' [G], choose('TP Use Lap Max' [] > 0, 'TP TCx Lap Max' [G], stat_max('TP TCx Session Max' [G])))

MathExpression.Comment: Current Y position on the traction circle
MathExpression.Script: max(0, abs('TP Ay' [G]) + 'TP Az' [G])
stat_max('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G], 1, range_change("Outings:Laps"))
stat_max('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G])
choose('TP Use Manual' [], 'TP TCy Manual' [G], choose('TP Use Lap Max' [] > 0, 'TP TCy Lap Max' [G], 'TP TCy Session Max' [G]))
choose(is_finite('TP Ax Max' [G]) AND is_finite('TP Ay Max' [G]), sqrt(sqr('TP Ax Max' [G]) + sqr('TP Ay Max' [G])), max('TP TCx' [G], 'TP TCy' [G]))

MathExpression.Comment: Ay value at the edge of the traction circle, assuming the current acceleration direction
MathExpression.Script: 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 / sqr('TP TCy' [G]) + sqr(('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G] / 'TP TCy Instantaneous' [G]) / 'TP TCx' [G]))

MathExpression.Comment: Ax value at the edge of the traction circle, assuming the current acceleration direction
MathExpression.Script: 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 / sqr('TP TCx' [G]) + sqr(('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G] / 'TP TCx Instantaneous' [G]) / 'TP TCy' [G]))

MathExpression.Comment: Ratio between the current acceleration magnitude and the theoretical limit from the traction circle extents
MathExpression.Script: choose('TP Traction Limited', sqrt(sqr('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G]) + sqr('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G])) / 'TP TC Radius' [G], invalid())
stat_mean('TP Utilization' [%], 1, range_change("Outings:Laps"))
integrate('TP Utilization' [ratio], 1, range_change("Outings:Laps")) / integrate(is_finite('TP Utilization' [ratio]), 1, range_change("Outings:Laps"))
choose('TP Traction Limited', 'TP TCy Instantaneous' [G] / sqrt(sqr('TP TCy' [G]) * (1.0 - sqr('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G] / 'TP TCx' [G]))), invalid())
choose('TP Traction Limited', abs('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G]) / sqrt(sqr('TP TCx' [G]) * (1.0 - sqr('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G] / 'TP TCy' [G]))), invalid())
choose('TP Traction Limited', sqrt(sqr('TP TCx Instantaneous' [G]) + sqr('TP TCy Instantaneous' [G])) / sqrt(sqr('TP TCx' [G]) + sqr('TP TCy' [G])), invalid())
choose('TP Traction Limited', sqrt(sqr('Accel Lat' [G]) + sqr('Accel Long' [G])) / sqrt(sqr('TP TCx' [G]) + sqr('TP TCy' [G])), invalid())
choose('TP Traction Limited', 'Throttle' [%], invalid())
choose('TP Traction Limited', 'Speed' [km/h], invalid())

MathExpression.Comment: Condition for when traction potential should be evaluated. Use throttle as a proxy, also limit on acceleration to filter out gear changes.
MathExpression.Script: 'TP Filter Throttle' > 0 OR 'TP Filter Throttle Latch' > 0

MathExpression.Comment: Condition for when traction potential should be evaluated. Use throttle as a proxy, also limit on acceleration to filter out gear changes.
MathExpression.Script: 'Throttle' [%] < 90

MathExpression.Comment: Condition for when traction potential should be evaluated. Use throttle as a proxy, also limit on acceleration to filter out gear changes.
MathExpression.Script: derivative('Throttle' [%], 0.5) > 10
